name: Pranav Patil
headline: I build the credit systems behind *Wio Bank*'s lending — and the *multi-agent AI* that investigates them when they break.
bio: What holds my attention is the *decision* behind a system — who it is for, what breaks without it, and which constraint you refuse to trade away. I'm an engineer moving toward product roles where *AI is the product, not the garnish*.

seo.title: Pranav Patil — Engineer building AI and fintech products
seo.description: Software engineer at Wio Bank building lending and payments systems, and WioGenie — a multi-agent AI incident investigator with citation-backed reasoning.
